import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Re-derive shape analysis for demo2 & demo3 with correct center coords
def centers(g):
    res=[]
    # find cells that are isolated differently-colored cells surrounded by 3s in plus/pattern
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    import collections
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and not(g[r][c]==3 and False)]
    # simpler: collect non-bg cells; cluster into diamonds (chebyshev-connected comps)
    seen=set(); 
    for p in pts:
        if p[0][0],p[0][1] in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            cur=stack.pop(); comp.append(cur); seen.add((cur[0],cur[1]))
            nb=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if 0<=r<cur[0] and 0<=c<W for r,c in [(0,0)]][:0]
        # messy; do proper flood with 8-conn on pts list coords
    # redo properly
    seen=set()
    for p in pts:
        if (p[0],p[1]) in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]; compset=set()
        while st:
            r,c,_=st.pop()
            if (r,c) in compset: continue
            compset.add((r,c)); comp.append((r,c,_))
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in compset:
                        st.append((nr,nc,g[nr][nc]))
        rs=[a for a,b,v in comp]; cs=[b for a,b,v in comp]
        cr,cc=min(rs)+max(0,(min(rs)+max(rs))//2), min(cs)+max(0,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2)
        # centroid approx: middle cell of comp
        mr=(sum(a for a,b,v in comp)/len(comp)); mc=(sum(b for a,b,v in comp)/len(comp))
        res.append((comp,mr,mc))
    return res

def fD(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    ps=find_pl(g); pts=set((p[0],p[1]) for p in ps)
    # gather per-column/row which emitters live there, sorted by distance order? use scan order
    em_rows={}; em_cols={}
    for r,c,v in ps:
        em_rows.setdefault(r,set()).add(v)
        em_cols.setdefault(c,set()).add(v)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    def paint(cells):
        for r,c in cells:
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in pts:
                res[r][c]=v
    # colored emitters
    for idx,(r,c,v) in enumerate(ps):
        if v==0: continue
        # horizontal: stop at next emitter row (any value) beyond; inclusive
        hits=[]
        for rr in range(H):
            if rr!=r and rr in em_rows: hits.append(rr)
        hits.sort()
        if hits: target=min(hits) if True else None
        # paint from c outward until hitting an emitter row
        rr = r+1
        while 0<=rr<H and rr != target:
            if g[rr][c]!=3: res[rr][c]=v
            rr+=1
        rr = r-1
        while 0<=rr<H and rr != target:
            if g[rr][c]!=3: res[rr][c]=v
            rr-=1
        # vertical similarly
        cc = c+1
        while 0<=cc<W and cc != target:
            if g[r][cc]!=3: res[r][cc]=v
            cc+=1
        cc = c-1
        while 0<=cc<W and cc != target:
            if g[r][cc]!=3: res[r][cc]=v
            cc-=1
    return res
